description: Prepare a one-page board brief on a question about AI adoption, from rated evidence only. Returns the company cases by the kind of work AI was used for, the themes (with practice counts for the company’s size), the claim checks and figure groups, and how to write the brief: open the cases for the work in question and one to three themes, fetch eight to twelve records and write from them. Use it when someone needs a summary for a board, an owner or an investment committee. To review a written plan, use review_ai_transformation_plan.

industry.description: The site’s industry category, if one fits: professional-services (consulting, accounting, audit, law), agencies (marketing, advertising, creative), ecommerce-retail (online shops, retail, wholesale), manufacturing. Map the user’s words, in any language, to one of these; if none fits (a bank, a hospital, a public body), leave it out.

size.description: Company size band: micro-small, medium, mid-market, enterprise (1–49, 50–249, 250–999, 1,000+ employees). Or pass employees instead.
